name: SOW Draft
description: Statement of Work draft for legal review. Mostly legal boilerplate + engine-filled engagement facts. AI writes the in-scope description and the deliverables summary so the legal team has a concrete starting point shaped by the actual engagement findings.

sections.title: In-scope services
sections.purpose: 3–5 sentences describing the services in scope of this SOW. Anchor concretely in the engagement's recommendations + target-state direction. Use professional commercial language suitable for a client-facing legal document. Avoid product names unless they're commercially agreed. No bullet lists — flowing prose only.

sections.title: Deliverables summary
sections.purpose: 3–5 markdown bullets enumerating the proposed deliverables for this engagement, derived from the assessment outputs (e.g. 'Target-state architecture', 'Risk register', 'Implementation roadmap'). Each bullet: deliverable name + one-line description of its content. Do NOT invent acceptance dates or rework allowances — that's legal's job downstream.
